create_Step3p5ExpertMLP: create a single expert MLP module with gate_proj, up_proj, and down_proj layers for MoE models
build_SequentialStep3p5MoeExperts: build a ModuleList that converts fused MoELinear weights into individual Step3p5ExpertMLP modules per expert
build_LinearStep3p5MoEMLP: build a replacement module that splits fused MoELinear into individual nn.Linear per expert for quantization
run_LinearStep3p5MoEMLP_forward: run the forward pass of LinearStep3p5MoEMLP to route hidden states through selected experts with routing weights
test_LinearStep3p5MoEMLP_router_bias_fun: test the router bias function that applies sigmoid gating with bias and top-k expert selection
